title: Barcelona chasing a significant statistical milestone against Deportivo Alaves
tweet: Barcelona enter the match with 99 goals against Alaves – one more will hit the century mark. Their average of over three goals this season makes the milestone plausible, but the priority remains a win to erase the losses to PSG and Real Madrid.

title: Confirmed: Barcelona starting lineup against Deportivo Alaves – academy product debuts
tweet: Barcelona’s first‑team start against Alavés today features academy graduate Brian Farinas at right‑back and Frenkie de Jong as a centre‑back, with Joao Cancelo on the left and Pau Cubarsi in the centre. The midfield trident remains Pedri, Rodri and Fermin Lopez, while Raphinha, Lamine Yamal, and Karim Adeyemi line up upfront, replacing Anthony Gordon. The lineup shows Flick’s confidence in youth, but the long‑term impact of these changes remains to be seen.
